releaseNotes: Text blocks keep their readable content height when switching from Text to Pen, Marker or Eraser
A dedicated persistent Aa Textoptionen button replaces the unreliable flashing BOOX popup path
Empty text blocks are automatically removed when leaving Text mode or after an empty block loses focus
The text options panel also includes an explicit Textblock löschen action for manual cleanup
Automatic text growth continues horizontally to the right and then vertically after wrapping
Text content, formatting, size and position remain persisted
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
